title: Home Mortgage Loans: Lapse of Applications That Do Not Close
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: Lapse of Applications That Do Not Close

An application for any of the Home Mortgage Loans has a limited life. If the loan has not closed by the time the program's funding window has run out, the application is withdrawn. This page fixes exactly when that happens.

## Clause

An application that has not closed is withdrawn once the program's funding window, counted in calendar days from the day the application was recorded, has fully run.

## How the days are counted

- **Starting point.** The clock starts from the application date held in the bank's records for that application — the day it was recorded. What the customer recalls about when they applied does not move the start.
- **Day 1.** The calendar day immediately after the application date is day 1. Weekends and holidays are counted like any other day.
- **Lapse point.** The application has lapsed when today's date is the same as, or later than, the application date advanced by the number of days in the program's funding window. The day on which the window's last day falls is itself a lapse day.
- **Which application.** The test is run for the particular application being considered, using that application's own recorded date.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Input read from the records | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| The application has closed | the funding window no longer matters | not withdrawn under this clause |
| Not closed; today is before the application date advanced by the window | window still running | not withdrawn under this clause |
| Not closed; today equals or is after the application date advanced by the window | window has run | withdrawn |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical window of 20 days)

The window length and dates below are invented purely to show the counting; the real window is the one published for the loan's program.

- The application was recorded on 3 March. Day 1 is 4 March, and the application date advanced by 20 days is 23 March.
- On 22 March the application is still inside its window, so it has not lapsed.
- On 23 March the lapse point has been reached, so the unclosed application is withdrawn.
- On any date after 23 March the result is the same: lapsed.
